ifrit/ifrit_hypnotic.json.description: Ifrits with this racial trait evoke the entrancing nature of flame, adding +1 to the DC for all saving throws against spells or effects they cast that inflict the fascinated condition. Once per day, when a creature rolls a saving throw against such an effect from the ifrit, the ifrit can spend an immediate action to force that creature to reroll the saving throw and use the second result, even if it is worse. The ifrit must announce he is using this ability before the results of the first roll are revealed. This racial trait replaces fire affinity.
ifrit/ifrit_hypnotic.json.name: Hypnotic

ifrit/ifrit_wildfire_heart.json.description: Ifrits with this trait are as swift and dangerous as a blazing wildfire. They gain a +4 racial bonus on initiative checks. This racial trait replaces energy resistance.
ifrit/ifrit_wildfire_heart.json.name: Wildfire Heart

kitsune/kitsune_ability_scores.json.description: Kitsune are agile and companionable, but tend to be physically weak.
kitsune/kitsune_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, -2 Strength

kitsune/kitsune_agile.json.description: Kitsune receive a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics checks.
kitsune/kitsune_agile.json.name: Agile

kitsune/kitsune_change_shape.json.description: A kitsune can assume the appearance of a specific single human form of the same sex. The kitsune always takes this specific form when she uses this ability. A kitsune in human form cannot use her bite attack, but gains a +10 racial bonus on Disguise checks made to appear human. Changing shape is a standard action. This ability otherwise functions as alter self, except that the kitsune does not adjust her ability scores.
kitsune/kitsune_change_shape.json.name: Change Shape

kitsune/kitsune_fast_shifter.json.description: You were born with an innate talent for switching between your natural forms. Using your racial change shape ability is a move action instead of a standard action. This racial trait replaces kitsune magic.
kitsune/kitsune_fast_shifter.json.name: Fast Shifter

kitsune/kitsune_gregarious.json.description: Even among your own kind, your gift for making friends stands out. Whenever you successfully use Diplomacy to win over an individual, that creature takes a -2 penalty to resist any of your Charisma-based skill checks for the next 24 hours. This racial trait replaces agile.
kitsune/kitsune_gregarious.json.name: Gregarious

kitsune/kitsune_kitsune_magic.json.description: Kitsune add 1 to the DCs of any saving throws to resist enchantment spells that they cast. Kitsune with a Charisma score of 11 or higher gain the following spell-like ability: 3/day--dancing lights.
kitsune/kitsune_kitsune_magic.json.name: Kitsune Magic

kitsune/kitsune_languages.json.description: Kitsune begin play speaking Common and Sylvan. Kitsune with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: any human language, Aklo, Celestial, Elven, Gnome, and Tengu.
kitsune/kitsune_languages.json.name: Languages

kitsune/kitsune_natural_weapons.json.description: In her natural form, a kitsune has a bite attack that deals 1d4 points of damage.
kitsune/kitsune_natural_weapons.json.name: Natural Weapons

kitsune/kitsune_size.json.description: Kitsune are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
kitsune/kitsune_size.json.name: Medium

kitsune/kitsune_speed.json.description: Kitsune have a base speed of 30 feet.
kitsune/kitsune_speed.json.name: Normal Speed

kitsune/kitsune_type.json.description: Kitsune are humanoids with the kitsune and shapechanger subtypes.
kitsune/kitsune_type.json.name: Kitsune

kitsune/kitsune_vision.json.description: Kitsune can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
kitsune/kitsune_vision.json.name: Low-Light Vision

kobold/kobold_beast_bond.json.description: Some kobolds have a talent for training animals and beasts to help them both on and off the battlefield. Kobolds with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Handle Animal and Ride checks. Handle Animal and Ride are always class skills for them. This racial trait replaces crafty.
kobold/kobold_beast_bond.json.name: Beast Bond

kobold/kobold_dragon_scaled.json.description: Some kobolds are hatched with scales of such vivid color that their connection to a particular sort of chromatic dragon seems undeniable. Whether this coloration is just a quirk of a stray egg or a trait shared by all the members of a tribe, these kobolds gain a resistance that makes them especially suited to work alongside dragons matching the color of the kobold's scales. Black-scaled and green-scaled kobolds with this racial trait gain acid resistance 5. Blue-scaled kobolds with this racial trait gain electricity resistance 5. Red-scaled kobolds with this racial trait gain fire resistance 5. White-scaled kobolds with this racial trait gain cold resistance 5. This racial trait replaces the armor racial trait.
kobold/kobold_dragon_scaled.json.name: Dragon-Scaled

kobold/kobold_gliding_wings.json.description: Some kobolds are born with wings that, while too weak for actual flying, do allow them to fall at a very slow and safe pace. A kobold with wings can use them to glide. It can make a DC 15 Fly check to fall safely from any height without taking falling damage, as if using feather fall. When falling safely, it may make an additional DC 15 Fly check to glide, moving 5 feet laterally for every 20 feet it falls. This racial trait replaces crafty.
kobold/kobold_gliding_wings.json.name: Gliding Wings

kobold/kobold_jester.json.description: Some kobolds swallow their pride and survive by groveling, placating, and amusing the powerful. Kobolds with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Perform checks. Diplomacy and Perform are always class skills for them. This racial trait replaces crafty.
kobold/kobold_jester.json.name: Jester

merfolk/merfolk_darkvision.json.description: Some merfolk favor the lightless depths over shallower waters. Merfolk with this racial trait gain darkvision with a range of 60 feet and light sensitivity. This racial trait replaces low-light vision.
merfolk/merfolk_darkvision.json.name: Darkvision

merfolk/merfolk_seasinger.json.description: The beautiful voices of the merfolk are legendary. A seasinger gains a +2 racial bonus on Perform (sing) checks and a +1 racial bonus to the save DC of language-dependent spells. This racial trait replaces low-light vision.
merfolk/merfolk_seasinger.json.name: Seasinger

merfolk/merfolk_strongtail.json.description: A few merfolk have broad, strong tails that are more suited for land travel than the typical merfolk tail. Merfolk with this racial trait have a land speed of 15 feet and a swim speed of 30 feet.
merfolk/merfolk_strongtail.json.name: Strongtail

nagaji/nagaji_ability_scores.json.description: Nagaji are strong and have forceful personalities, but they tend to ignore logic and mock scholarly pursuits.
nagaji/nagaji_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Strength, +2 Charisma, -2 Intelligence

nagaji/nagaji_armored_scales.json.description: Nagaji have a +1 natural armor bonus because of their scaly flesh.
nagaji/nagaji_armored_scales.json.name: Armored Scales

nagaji/nagaji_hypnotic_gaze.json.description: The nagaji's gaze is so intense it stops others in their tracks. Once per day, it can attempt to hypnotize a single target, as per the spell hypnotism (caster level equal to the nagaji's Hit Dice). The DC of this effect is equal to 11 + the nagaji's Charisma modifier. The effects of the hypnotic gaze only last a single round. This racial trait replaces serpent's sense. &nl;(CL , DC )
nagaji/nagaji_hypnotic_gaze.json.name: Hypnotic Gaze

nagaji/nagaji_languages.json.description: Nagaji begin play speaking Common and Nagaji. Nagaji with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: any human tongue, Abyssal, Aklo, Celestial, Draconic, Giant, Infernal, and Sylvan.
nagaji/nagaji_languages.json.name: Languages

nagaji/nagaji_resistant.json.description: Nagaji receive a +2 racial saving throw bonus against mind-affecting effects and poison.
nagaji/nagaji_resistant.json.name: Resistant

nagaji/nagaji_serpent_s_sense.json.description: Nagaji receive a +2 racial bonus on Handle Animal checks against reptiles, and a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.
nagaji/nagaji_serpent_s_sense.json.name: Serpent's Sense

nagaji/nagaji_size.json.description: Nagaji are humanoids with the reptilian subtype.
nagaji/nagaji_size.json.name: Reptilian

nagaji/nagaji_speed.json.description: Nagaji have a base speed of 30 feet.
nagaji/nagaji_speed.json.name: Normal Speed

nagaji/nagaji_type.json.description: Nagaji are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
nagaji/nagaji_type.json.name: Medium

nagaji/nagaji_vision.json.description: Nagaji can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
nagaji/nagaji_vision.json.name: Low-Light Vision

orc/feral_languages.json.description: Feral orcs begin play speaking no languages. Orcs with high Intelligence scores can choose from among the following bonus languages: Dwarven, Giant, Gnoll, Goblin, Undercommon.
orc/feral_languages.json.name: Languages

orc/orc.json.description: You were adopted and raised by orcs.
orc/orc.json.name: Orc

orc/orc_dayrunner.json.description: Orcs refuse to yield to any foe, including the sun. Some spend hour upon hour glaring at the sun until their ruined eyes acclimatize to bright light. Orcs with this racial trait take a -2 penalty on all ranged attack rolls. This racial trait replaces light sensitivity.
orc/orc_dayrunner.json.name: Dayrunner

orc/orc_feral.json.description: Orcs have the ability to fend for themselves long before they master the rudiments of their language and culture. Having needed to hunt bugs and tiny animals for food to survive while still infants, feral orcs fight all the harder to survive when at the brink of death. Orcs with this racial trait gain Survival as a class skill and gain a +1 racial bonus on melee weapon attack and damage rolls when at negative hit points. This racial trait replaces the orc's weapon familiarity and automatic languages. Feral orcs without additional languages due to high Intelligence scores or ranks in Linguistics can only communicate with grunts and gestures.
orc/orc_feral.json.name: Feral

orc/orc_smeller.json.description: Orcs with this racial trait gain a limited scent ability with half the normal range. This racial trait replaces ferocity and weapon familiarity.
orc/orc_smeller.json.name: Smeller

orc/orc_squalid.json.description: Some orcs exist in surroundings so filthy and pestilent that even other orcs would have difficulty living in them. Orcs with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws made to resist nausea, the sickened condition, and disease. This racial trait replaces ferocity.
orc/orc_squalid.json.name: Squalid

oread/oread_crystalline_form.json.description: Oreads with this trait gain a +2 racial bonus to AC against rays thanks to their reflective crystalline skin. In addition, once per day, they can deflect a single ray attack targeted at them as if they were using the Deflect Arrows feat. This racial trait replaces earth affinity.
oread/oread_crystalline_form.json.name: Crystalline Form

oread/oread_earth_insight.json.description: Oread spellcasters sometimes find that their elemental heritage makes creatures of earth more willing to serve them. Summon monster and summon nature's ally spells that such oreads cast last 2 rounds longer than normal when used to summon creatures with the earth subtype. This racial trait replaces earth affinity.
oread/oread_earth_insight.json.name: Earth Insight

oread/oread_ferrous_growth.json.description: Oreads with this racial trait learn how to mimic the magic of their shaitan ancestors. Once per day, such an oread can cause a touched piece of nonmagical iron or steel to grow into an object up to 10 pounds in weight, such as a sword, crowbar, or light steel shield. This object remains in this form for 10 minutes or until broken or destroyed, at which point it shrinks back to its original size and shape. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.
oread/oread_ferrous_growth.json.name: Ferrous Growth

oread/oread_fertile_soil.json.description: Oread sorcerers with the verdant bloodline treat their Charisma score as 2 points higher for all sorcerer spells and class abilities. Oread clerics with the Plant domain use their domain powers and spells at +1 caster level. This racial trait replaces earth affinity.
oread/oread_fertile_soil.json.name: Fertile Soil

oread/oread_granite_skin.json.description: Rocky growths cover the skin of oreads with this racial trait. They gain a +1 racial bonus to natural armor. This racial trait replaces energy resistance.
oread/oread_granite_skin.json.name: Granite Skin

oread/oread_mountain_born.json.description: Oreads are drawn to mountains and other high places, and after many generations they've grown well suited to their environment. Oreads with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics checks made to cross narrow ledges and on saves against altitude fatigue and sickness. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.
oread/oread_mountain_born.json.name: Mountain-Born

oread/oread_stone_in_the_blood.json.description: Oreads with this racial trait mimic the healing abilities of the mephits, gaining fast healing 2 for 1 round anytime they are subject to acid damage (the acid damage does not need to overcome the oread's resistances or immunities to activate this ability). The oread can heal up to 2 hit points per level per day with this ability, after which it ceases to function. This racial trait replaces earth affinity.
oread/oread_stone_in_the_blood.json.name: Stone in the Blood

oread/oread_treacherous_earth.json.description: Once per day, an oread with this racial trait can will the earth to rumble and shift, transforming a 10-foot-radius patch of earth, unworked stone, or sand into an area of difficult terrain, centered on an area the oread touches. This lasts for a number of minutes equal to the oread's level, after which the ground returns to normal. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.
oread/oread_treacherous_earth.json.name: Treacherous Earth

ratfolk/ratfolk_ability_scores.json.description: Ratfolk are agile and clever, yet physically weak.
ratfolk/ratfolk_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, -2 Strength

ratfolk/ratfolk_cornered_fury.json.description: Ratfolk can fight viciously when cut off from friends and allies. Whenever a ratfolk with this racial trait is reduced to half or fewer of his hit points, and has no conscious ally within 30 feet, he gains a +2 racial bonus on melee attack rolls and to Armor Class. This racial trait replaces swarming.
ratfolk/ratfolk_cornered_fury.json.name: Cornered Fury

ratfolk/ratfolk_languages.json.description: Ratfolk begin play speaking Common. Ratfolk with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Aklo, Draconic, Dwarven, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Halfling, Orc, and Undercommon.
ratfolk/ratfolk_languages.json.name: Languages

ratfolk/ratfolk_rodent_empathy.json.description: Ratfolk gain a +4 racial bonus on Handle Animal checks made to influence rodents.
ratfolk/ratfolk_rodent_empathy.json.name: Rodent Empathy

ratfolk/ratfolk_scent.json.description: Some ratfolk have much more strongly developed senses of smell, instead of keen eyes and ears. These ratfolk have the scent ability, but take a -2 penalty on all Perception checks based primarily on sight or hearing. This racial trait replaces tinker.
ratfolk/ratfolk_scent.json.name: Scent

ratfolk/ratfolk_size.json.description: Ratfolk are Small and gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty on combat maneuver checks and to their Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.
ratfolk/ratfolk_size.json.name: Small

ratfolk/ratfolk_skulk.json.description: Some ratfolk can blend easily into their environments, and move with surprising grace. Ratfolk gain a +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks, and take only a -5 penalty on Stealth checks made to hide from creatures they have distracted with a Bluff check (rather than the normal -10 penalty). This racial trait replaces tinker.
ratfolk/ratfolk_skulk.json.name: Skulk

ratfolk/ratfolk_speed.json.description: Ratfolk have a base speed of 20 feet.
ratfolk/ratfolk_speed.json.name: Slow Speed

ratfolk/ratfolk_swarming.json.description: Ratfolk are used to living and fighting communally, and are adept at swarming foes for their own gain and their foes' detriment. Up to two ratfolk can share the same square at the same time. If two ratfolk in the same square attack the same foe, they are considered to be flanking that foe as if they were in two opposite squares.
ratfolk/ratfolk_swarming.json.name: Swarming

ratfolk/ratfolk_tinker.json.description: Ratfolk gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy), Perception, and Use Magic Device checks.
ratfolk/ratfolk_tinker.json.name: Tinker

ratfolk/ratfolk_type.json.description: Ratfolk are humanoids with the ratfolk subtype.
ratfolk/ratfolk_type.json.name: Ratfolk

ratfolk/ratfolk_unnatural.json.description: Some ratfolk unnerve normal animals, and train to defend themselves against the inevitable attacks from such creatures. These ratfolk take a -4 penalty on all Charisma-based skill checks to affect creatures of the animal type, and receive a +2 dodge bonus to AC against animals. An animal's starting attitude toward ratfolk is one step worse than normal. This racial trait replaces rodent empathy.
ratfolk/ratfolk_unnatural.json.name: Unnatural

ratfolk/ratfolk_vision.json.description: Ratfolk can see in the dark up to 60 feet.
ratfolk/ratfolk_vision.json.name: Darkvision

samsaran/samsaran_ability_scores.json.description: Samsarans are insightful and strong-minded, but with frail bodies.
samsaran/samsaran_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom, -2 Constitution

samsaran/samsaran_languages.json.description: Samsarans begin play speaking Common and Samsaran. Samsarans with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: any human language, Abyssal, Aquan, Auran, Celestial, Draconic, Giant, Ignan, Infernal, Nagaji, Tengu, and Terran.
samsaran/samsaran_languages.json.name: Languages

samsaran/samsaran_lifebound.json.description: Samsarans gain a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws to resist death effects, saving throws against negative energy effects, Fortitude saves to remove negative levels, and Constitution checks to stabilize if reduced to negative hit points.
samsaran/samsaran_lifebound.json.name: Lifebound

samsaran/samsaran_samsaran_magic.json.description: Samsarans with a Charisma score of 11 or higher gain the following spell-like abilities: 1/day--comprehend languages, deathwatch, and stabilize. The caster level for these effects equals the samsaran's character level.
samsaran/samsaran_samsaran_magic.json.name: Samsaran Magic

samsaran/samsaran_shards_of_the_past.jso.description: A samsaran's past lives grant her bonuses on two skills. The samsaran chooses two skills--she gains a +2 racial bonus on both, and they are always class skills for her. Once made, this choice can't be altered.
samsaran/samsaran_shards_of_the_past.jso.name: Shards of the Past

samsaran/samsaran_size.json.description: Samsarans are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
samsaran/samsaran_size.json.name: Medium

samsaran/samsaran_speed.json.description: Samsarans have a base speed of 30 feet.
samsaran/samsaran_speed.json.name: Normal Speed

samsaran/samsaran_type.json.description: Samsarans are humanoids with the samsaran subtype.
samsaran/samsaran_type.json.name: Samsaran

samsaran/samsaran_vision.json.description: Samsarans can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
samsaran/samsaran_vision.json.name: Low-Light Vision

strix/strix_ability_scores.json.description: Strix are swift and elusive, but tend to be stubborn and swift to anger.
strix/strix_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Dexterity, -2 Charisma

strix/strix_darkvision.json.description: Strix can see in the dark up to 60 feet.
strix/strix_darkvision.json.name: Darkvision

strix/strix_dayguard.json.description: Familiar with watching over its tribe during the day, the strix gains a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks and treats Perception as a class skill. This racial trait replaces nocturnal.
strix/strix_dayguard.json.name: Dayguard

strix/strix_flight.json.description: Strix have a fly speed of 60 feet (average).
strix/strix_flight.json.name: Flight

strix/strix_frightening.json.description: The strix looks particularly menacing and use this to its advantage, gaining a +2 racial bonus on Intimidate checks. This racial trait replaces nocturnal.
strix/strix_frightening.json.name: Frightening

strix/strix_hatred.json.description: Strix receive a +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures of the human subtype because of their special training against these hated foes.
strix/strix_hatred.json.name: Hatred

strix/strix_languages.json.description: Strix begin play speaking Strix. Those with high Intelligence scores can choose any of the following languages: Auran, Azlanti, Common, Draconic, Giant, Gnome, Goblin, and Infernal.
strix/strix_languages.json.name: Languages

strix/strix_low_light_vision.json.description: Strix can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
strix/strix_low_light_vision.json.name: Low-Light Vision

strix/strix_nimble.json.description: The strix receives a +1 racial bonus on Reflex saves. This replaces the suspicious racial trait.
strix/strix_nimble.json.name: Nimble

target_bonuses.target: Perception=in dim light or darkness,Stealth=in dim light or darkness

strix/strix_nocturnal.json.description: Strix gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Stealth checks in dim light or darkness.
strix/strix_nocturnal.json.name: Nocturnal

strix/strix_size.json.description: Strix are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
strix/strix_size.json.name: Medium

strix/strix_speed.json.description: Strix have a base speed of 30 feet on land.
strix/strix_speed.json.name: Normal Speed

strix/strix_suspicious.json.description: Strix receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against illusion spells or effects.
strix/strix_suspicious.json.name: Suspicious

strix/strix_tough.json.description: The strix receives a +1 racial bonus on Fortitude saves. This racial trait replaces suspicious.
strix/strix_tough.json.name: Tough

strix/strix_type.json.description: Strix are humanoids with the strix subtype
strix/strix_type.json.name: Strix

strix/strix_wing_clipped.json.description: The flight of wing-clipped strix is weaker than normal, whether from deformity or injury. Their fly speed is 20 feet (poor) instead of the normal fly speed, and they must make a DC 30 Fly check to fly upward. Ostracized by their tribes and forced to deal with other races, these strix compensate for their weakness by gaining a +2 racial bonus on Bluff, Climb, and Diplomacy checks.
strix/strix_wing_clipped.json.name: Wing-Clipped

strix/wing_clipped_strix_flight.json.description: Wing-clipped strix have a fly speed of 20 feet (poor).
strix/wing_clipped_strix_flight.json.name: Flight

suli/suli_ability_scores.json.description: Sulis are brawny and charming, but slow-witted.
suli/suli_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Strength, +2 Charisma, -2 Intelligence

suli/suli_earthfoot.json.description: Whenever the suli moves through difficult terrain related to earth and stone (rubble, mud, sand, and so on), she may move through 5 feet of that difficult terrain each round as if it were normal terrain. This allows the suli to take a 5-foot step into that difficult terrain. Other kinds of difficult terrain (ice, caltrops, foliage, and so on) affect the suli normally.
suli/suli_earthfoot.json.name: Earthfoot

suli/suli_elemental_assault.json.description: Once per day as a swift action, a suli can shroud her arms in acid, cold, electricity, or fire. This effect lasts for rounds (1 round per level) and can be dismissed as a free action. Unarmed strikes with her arms or hands (or attacks with weapons held in those hands) deal +1d6 points of damage of the appropriate energy type.
suli/suli_elemental_assault.json.name: Elemental Assault

suli/suli_energy_resistance.json.description: Sulis have resistance to acid 5, cold 5, electricity 5, and fire 5.
suli/suli_energy_resistance.json.name: Energy Resistance

suli/suli_energy_strike.json.description: A suli with this racial trait has a stronger connection to one energy type than to the other three used by sulis. Choose one energy type: acid, cold, electricity, or fire. The suli's elemental assault ability can only deal energy damage of this type. The suli has resistance 5 to this energy type and no racial resistance to the other three types. While her elemental assault is active, the suli gains an additional ability based on the chosen energy type. This racial trait otherwise works like and replaces elemental assault. &nl;Once per day as a swift action, a suli can shroud her arms in the chosen energy type. This effect lasts for rounds (1 round per level) and can be dismissed as a free action. Unarmed strikes with her arms or hands (or attacks with weapons held in those hands) deal +1d6 points of damage of the chosen energy type.
suli/suli_energy_strike.json.name: Energy Strike

suli/suli_firehand.json.description: Instead of adding damage to a melee attack, the suli may hurl a piece of her arm-flames as if it were a thrown weapon. The suli makes a ranged touch attack; if the attack hits, the target takes 1d6 points of fire damage. The flames have a range increment of 10 feet.
suli/suli_firehand.json.name: Firehand

suli/suli_icewalk.json.description: The suli can walk on water-based liquids as if using water walk, except instead of hovering above the surface, she creates a temporary layer of ice that supports her and immediately melts once she moves away from it. This ice is not slippery to the suli and does not affect her balance or speed, though other ice affects her normally. Other creatures cannot travel on this ice, but the suli may carry a creature while moving.
suli/suli_icewalk.json.name: Icewalk

suli/suli_languages.json.description: Sulis begin play speaking Common and one elemental language (Aquan, Auran, Ignan, or Terran). Sulis with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Aquan, Auran, Draconic, Ignan, and Terran.
suli/suli_languages.json.name: Languages

suli/suli_negotiator.json.description: Sulis are keen negotiators, and gain a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Sense Motive checks.
suli/suli_negotiator.json.name: Negotiator

suli/suli_shockshield.json.description: Once per round as an immediate action, the suli can shock a creature that touches or attacks her with a natural attack, unarmed strike, or metal melee weapon, dealing 1d6 points of electricity damage to the creature.
suli/suli_shockshield.json.name: Shockshield

suli/suli_size.json.description: Sulis are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
suli/suli_size.json.name: Medium

suli/suli_speed.json.description: Sulis have a base speed of 30 feet.
suli/suli_speed.json.name: Normal Speed

suli/suli_type.json.description: Sulis are outsiders with the native subtype.
suli/suli_type.json.name: Native Outsider

suli/suli_vision.json.description: Sulis can see twice as far as humans in dim light.
suli/suli_vision.json.name: Low-Light Vision

svirfneblin/svirfneblin_healthy.json.description: Svirfneblin gain a +4 bonus on Fortitude saves against disease and poison, including magical diseases. This racial trait replaces fortunate.
svirfneblin/svirfneblin_healthy.json.name: Healthy

svirfneblin/svirfneblin_stoneseer.json.description: Svirfneblin add +1 to the caster level of any spells with the earth descriptor they cast. Svirfneblin also gain the following spell-like abilities: Constant--nondetection; 1/day--magic stone, stone shape, stone tell; caster level equals the svirfneblin's class levels. This racial trait replaces svirfneblin magic.
svirfneblin/svirfneblin_stoneseer.json.name: Stoneseer

sylph/sylph_air_insight.json.description: Sylph spellcasters sometimes find that their elemental heritage makes creatures of air more willing to serve them. Summon monster and summon nature's ally spells that the sylph casts last 2 rounds longer than normal when used to summon creatures with the air subtype. This racial trait replaces air affinity.
sylph/sylph_air_insight.json.name: Air Insight

sylph/sylph_breeze_kissed.json.description: Breezes seem to follow most sylphs wherever they go, but some sylphs are better able to control these winds than others. A sylph with this racial trait surrounds herself with swirling winds, gaining a +2 racial bonus to AC against nonmagical ranged attacks. The sylph can calm or renew these winds as a swift action. Once per day, the sylph can channel this wind into a single gust, making a bull rush or trip combat maneuver attempt against one creature within 30 feet. Whether or not the attempt succeeds, the winds are exhausted and no longer provide a bonus to the sylph's AC for 24 hours. This is a supernatural ability. This racial trait replaces air affinity.
sylph/sylph_breeze_kissed.json.name: Breeze-Kissed

sylph/sylph_like_the_wind.json.description: A sylph with this racial trait gains a +5 foot bonus to her base speed. This racial trait replaces energy resistance.
sylph/sylph_like_the_wind.json.name: Like the Wind

automatic_trait_grants: Racial SLA ~ Speak with Animals (birds or other flying animals only)
sylph/sylph_sky_speaker.json.description: Sylphs with this racial trait feel kinship toward the creatures of the air, and can use speak with animals once per day to speak to birds or other flying animals. Her caster level for these effects is equal to her level. This racial trait replaces the sylph's spell-like ability racial trait.
sylph/sylph_sky_speaker.json.name: Sky Speaker

sylph/sylph_storm_in_the_blood.json.description: A sylph with this racial trait gains fast healing 2 for 1 round anytime she takes electricity damage (whether or not this electricity damage gets through her electricity resistance). The sylph can heal up to 2 hit points per level per day with this ability, after which it ceases to function. This racial trait replaces air affinity.
sylph/sylph_storm_in_the_blood.json.name: Storm in the Blood

sylph/sylph_thunderous_resilience.json.description: Sylphs with this racial trait gain sonic resistance 5. This racial trait replaces energy resistance.
sylph/sylph_thunderous_resilience.json.name: Thunderous Resilience

sylph/sylph_weather_savvy.json.description: Some sylphs are so in tune with the air and sky that they can sense the slightest change in atmospheric conditions. Sylphs with this trait can spend a full-round action to predict the weather in an area for the next 24 hours. The sylph's prediction is always accurate, but cannot account for spells or supernatural effects that might alter the forecast. This racial trait replaces the sylph's spell-like ability racial trait.
sylph/sylph_weather_savvy.json.name: Weather Savvy

sylph/sylph_whispering_wind.json.description: Some sylphs are especially thin and wispy, as though they were made more of air than flesh. Sylphs with this racial trait gain a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks. This racial trait replaces the sylph's spell-like ability racial trait.
sylph/sylph_whispering_wind.json.name: Whispering Wind

tengu/tengu_carrion_sense.json.description: Many tengus have a natural ability to sniff out carrion. While their sense of smell isn't as keen as that of other species, it is particularly attuned to the scent of injuries or death. Tengus with this racial trait have a limited scent ability, which only functions for corpses and badly wounded creatures (50% or fewer hit points). This racial trait replaces gifted linguist.
tengu/tengu_carrion_sense.json.name: Carrion Sense

tengu/tengu_claw_attack.json.description: Tengus with this racial trait have learned to use their claws as natural weapons. They gain two claw attacks as primary natural attacks that deal 1d3 points of damage, and are treated as having the Improved Unarmed Strike feat for the purpose of qualifying for other feats. This racial trait replaces swordtrained.
tengu/tengu_claw_attack.json.name: Claw Attack

tengu/tengu_exotic_weapon_training.json.description: Instead of swords, some tengus are trained in exotic weaponry. Such tengus choose a number of eastern weapons equal to 3 + their Intelligence bonus, and gain proficiency with these weapons. This racial trait replaces swordtrained.
tengu/tengu_exotic_weapon_training.json.name: Exotic Weapon Training

tengu/tengu_glide.json.description: Some tengus can use their feathered arms and legs to glide. Tengus with this racial trait can make a DC 15 Fly check to fall safely from any height without taking falling damage, as if using feather fall. When falling safely, a tengu may make an additional DC 15 Fly check to glide, moving 5 feet laterally for every 20 feet he falls. This racial trait replaces gifted linguist.
tengu/tengu_glide.json.name: Glide

tiefling/asura_spawn_ability_scores.json.description: These tieflings take particular glee in seeing the gods and their worshipers fail.
tiefling/asura_spawn_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, -2 Intelligence

tiefling/asura_spawn_skilled.json.description: Faultspawn have a +2 racial bonus on Appraise and Knowledge (local) checks.
tiefling/asura_spawn_skilled.json.name: Skilled

tiefling/asura_spawn_spell_like_ability..description: Faultspawn gain hideous laughter as a spell-like ability.
tiefling/asura_spawn_spell_like_ability..name: Spell-Like Ability

tiefling/daemon_spawn_ability_scores.jso.description: Bearing the blood of angels, these aasimars often appear androgynous.
tiefling/daemon_spawn_ability_scores.jso.name: +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, -2 Wisdom

tiefling/daemon_spawn_skilled.json.description: Grimspawn have a +2 racial bonus on Disable Device and Sleight of Hand checks.
tiefling/daemon_spawn_skilled.json.name: Skilled

tiefling/daemon_spawn_spell_like_ability.description: Grimspawn gain death knell as a spell-like ability.
tiefling/daemon_spawn_spell_like_ability.name: Spell-Like Ability

tiefling/demodand_spawn_ability_scores.j.description: These boorish tieflings enjoy violating taboos and breaking laws. They often bear hideous physical oddities or deformities.
tiefling/demodand_spawn_ability_scores.j.name: +2 Constitution, +2 Wisdom, -2 Intelligence

tiefling/demodand_spawn_skilled.json.description: Foulspawn have a +2 racial bonus on Intimidate and Knowledge (religion) checks.
tiefling/demodand_spawn_skilled.json.name: Skilled

tiefling/demodand_spawn_spell_like_abili.description: Foulspawn gain bear's endurance as a spell-like ability.
tiefling/demodand_spawn_spell_like_abili.name: Spell-Like Ability

tiefling/demon_spawn_ability_scores.json.description: The influence of the demonic Abyss grants these volatile tieflings their boundless appetites for destruction.
tiefling/demon_spawn_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Strength, +2 Charisma, -2 Intelligence

tiefling/demon_spawn_skilled.json.description: Pitborn have a +2 racial bonus on Disable Device and Perception checks.
tiefling/demon_spawn_skilled.json.name: Skilled

tiefling/demon_spawn_spell_like_ability..description: Pitborn gain shatter as a spell-like ability.
tiefling/demon_spawn_spell_like_ability..name: Spell-Like Ability

tiefling/devil_spawn_skilled.json.description: Hellspawn have a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Sense Motive checks.
tiefling/devil_spawn_skilled.json.name: Skilled

tiefling/devil_spawn_spell_like_ability..description: Hellspawn gain pyrotechnics as a spell-like ability.
tiefling/devil_spawn_spell_like_ability..name: Spell-Like Ability

tiefling/div_spawn_ability_scores.json.description: Lack of the ability to feel joy or pleasure defines these malicious tieflings, making them jealous of those who can.
tiefling/div_spawn_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, -2 Intelligence

tiefling/div_spawn_skilled.json.description: Spitespawn have a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Linguistics checks.
tiefling/div_spawn_skilled.json.name: Skilled

tiefling/div_spawn_spell_like_ability.js.description: Spitespawn gain misdirection as a spell-like ability.
tiefling/div_spawn_spell_like_ability.js.name: Spell-Like Ability

tiefling/kyton_spawn_skilled.json.description: Shackleborn have a +2 racial bonus on Escape Artist and Intimidate checks.
tiefling/kyton_spawn_skilled.json.name: Skilled

tiefling/kyton_spawn_spell_like_ability..description: Shackleborn gain web as a spell-like ability.
tiefling/kyton_spawn_spell_like_ability..name: Spell-Like Ability

tiefling/oni_spawn_skilled.json.description: Hungerseed have a +2 racial bonus on Disguise and Intimidate checks.
tiefling/oni_spawn_skilled.json.name: Skilled

tiefling/oni_spawn_spell_like_ability.js.description: Hungerseed gain alter self as a spell-like ability.
tiefling/oni_spawn_spell_like_ability.js.name: Spell-Like Ability

tiefling/qlippoth_spawn_ability_scores.j.description: The most hideous of their kind, these tieflings instinctively despise all other forms of mortal life.
tiefling/qlippoth_spawn_ability_scores.j.name: +2 Strength, +2 Wisdom, -2 Intelligence

tiefling/qlippoth_spawn_skilled.json.description: The motherless have a +2 racial bonus on Escape Artist and Survival checks.
tiefling/qlippoth_spawn_skilled.json.name: Skilled

tiefling/qlippoth_spawn_spell_like_abili.description: The motherless gain blur as a spell-like ability.
tiefling/qlippoth_spawn_spell_like_abili.name: Spell-Like Ability

tiefling/rakshasa_spawn_skilled.json.description: Beastbrood have a +2 racial bonus on Disguise and Sense Motive checks.
tiefling/rakshasa_spawn_skilled.json.name: Skilled

tiefling/rakshasa_spawn_spell_like_abili.description: Beastbrood gain detect thoughts as a spell-like ability.
tiefling/rakshasa_spawn_spell_like_abili.name: Spell-Like Ability

tiefling/tiefling_asura_spawn.json.description: These tieflings take particular glee in seeing the gods and their worshipers fail.
tiefling/tiefling_asura_spawn.json.name: Asura-Spawn (Faultspawn)

tiefling/tiefling_beguiling_liar.json.description: Many tieflings find that the best way to get along in the world is to tell others what they want to hear. These tieflings' practice of telling habitual falsehoods grants them a +4 racial bonus on Bluff checks to convince an opponent that what they are saying is true when they tell a lie. This racial trait replaces skilled.
tiefling/tiefling_beguiling_liar.json.name: Beguiling Liar

tiefling/tiefling_demodand_spawn.json.description: These boorish tieflings enjoy violating taboos and breaking laws. They often bear hideous physical oddities or deformities.
tiefling/tiefling_demodand_spawn.json.name: Demodand-Spawn (Foulspawn)

tiefling/tiefling_demon_spawn.json.description: The influence of the demonic Abyss grants these volatile tieflings their boundless appetites for destruction.
tiefling/tiefling_demon_spawn.json.name: Demon-Spawn (Pitborn)

tiefling/tiefling_div_spawn.json.description: Lack of the ability to feel joy or pleasure defines these malicious tieflings, making them jealous of those who can.
tiefling/tiefling_div_spawn.json.name: Div-Spawn (Spitespawn)

tiefling/tiefling_fiendish_sprinter.json.description: Some tieflings have feet that are more bestial than human. Whether their feet resemble those of a clawed predator or are the cloven hooves common to many of their kind, tieflings with this trait gain a 10-foot racial bonus to their speed when using the charge, run, or withdraw actions. This racial trait replaces skilled.
tiefling/tiefling_fiendish_sprinter.json.name: Fiendish Sprinter

tiefling/tiefling_maw_or_claw.json.description: Some tieflings take on the more bestial aspects of their fiendish ancestors. These tieflings exhibit either powerful, toothy maws or dangerous claws. The tiefling can choose a bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage or two claws that each deal 1d4 points of damage. These attacks are primary natural attacks. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.
tiefling/tiefling_maw_or_claw.json.name: Maw or Claw

tiefling/tiefling_prehensile_tail.json.description: Many tieflings have tails, but some have long, flexible tails that can be used to carry items. While they cannot wield weapons with their tails, they can use them to retrieve small, stowed objects carried on their persons as a swift action. This racial trait replaces fiendish sorcery.
tiefling/tiefling_prehensile_tail.json.name: Prehensile Tail

tiefling/tiefling_qlippoth_spawn.json.description: The most hideous of their kind, these tieflings instinctively despise all other forms of mortal life.
tiefling/tiefling_qlippoth_spawn.json.name: Qlippoth-Spawn (the Motherless)

tiefling/tiefling_scaled_skin.json.description: The skin of these tieflings provides some energy resistance, but is also as hard as armor. Choose one of the following energy types: cold, electricity, or fire. A tiefling with this trait gains resistance 5 in the chosen energy type and also gains a +1 natural armor bonus to AC. This racial trait replaces fiendish resistance.
tiefling/tiefling_scaled_skin.json.name: Scaled Skin

tiefling/tiefling_soul_seer.json.description: Rare tieflings have a peculiar sight that allows them to see the state of a creature's soul. They can use deathwatch at will as spell-like ability. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability and fiendish sorcery racial traits.
tiefling/tiefling_soul_seer.json.name: Soul Seer

tiefling/tiefling_vestigial_wings.json.description: Some tieflings possess a pair of undersized, withered, or stunted wings like a mockery of those of their fiendish forbearer. Sometimes these wings are leathery, like those of a bat. Other times they are covered with a scattering of black, red, or violet feathers. Rare manifestations can take even more bizarre forms. These wings do not provide the lift required for actual flight, but do have enough power to aid flight attained by some other method, and grant a +4 racial bonus on Fly skill checks. This racial trait replaces skilled.
tiefling/tiefling_vestigial_wings.json.name: Vestigial Wings

undine/undine_acid_breath.json.description: Undines whose outsider heritage can be traced to a water mephit can wield acid as a weapon. Such an undine has a breath weapon that is a 5-foot cone of acidic water usable once per day. The breath deals 1d8 points of acid damage per two character levels (maximum 5d8). A Reflex saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 the undine's level + the undine's Constitution modifier) halves the damage. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.
undine/undine_acid_breath.json.name: Acid Breath

undine/undine_amphibious.json.description: Some undines are born with a permanent bond to water. Undines with this racial trait gain the aquatic subtype and amphibious special quality. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.
undine/undine_amphibious.json.name: Amphibious

undine/undine_deepsight.json.description: The eyes of some undines are especially adapted to the lightless depths of the oceans, but not to air-filled environments. An undine with this racial trait has darkvision 120 feet when underwater, but otherwise has no darkvision at all. This racial trait replaces darkvision.
undine/undine_deepsight.json.name: Deepsight

undine/undine_flesh_chameleon.json.description: Some undines can change their coloration to match human skin tones. As a standard action, an undine with this racial trait can change her natural blue hue to match any normal human skin tone, and can revert to normal as a free action. This grants a +4 racial bonus on Disguise checks to appear human. This racial trait replaces energy resistance.
undine/undine_flesh_chameleon.json.name: Flesh Chameleon

undine/undine_hydrated_vitality.json.description: An undine with this racial trait gains fast healing 2 for 1 round anytime she submerges completely within a body of natural salt water, fresh water, or brackish water. Stagnant, poisoned, or trapped water (such as an artificial pit or a bag of holding) does not activate this ability. The undine can heal up to 2 hit points per level per day with this ability, after which it ceases to function. This racial trait replaces water affinity.
undine/undine_hydrated_vitality.json.name: Hydrated Vitality

undine/undine_nereid_fascination.json.description: Some undines can trace their ancestry to nereids as well as to outsiders. Once per day as a standard action, such an undine can create a 20-foot-radius aura that causes humanoids within the aura's range to become fascinated with her for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 the undine's character level (minimum 1). Targets may resist with a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the undine's level + the undine's Charisma modifier).&nl;(fascinate rounds, DC ) This is a supernatural ability. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.
undine/undine_nereid_fascination.json.name: Nereid Fascination

undine/undine_ooze_breath.json.description: Some undines' outsider heritage can be traced to ooze mephits. These undines have a breath weapon that is a 5-foot cone of slime usable once per day. The slime deals 1d4 points of acid damage per two character levels (maximum 5d4) and sickens creatures in the area for 3 rounds. A successful Reflex saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 the undine's level + the undine's Constitution modifier) halves the damage and negates the sickened effect. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.
undine/undine_ooze_breath.json.name: Ooze Breath

undine/undine_terrain_chameleon.json.description: Some undines can change their coloration to blend in with underwater terrain, mixing browns, grays, and greens to resemble kelp or other natural water plants. As a standard action, an undine with this racial trait can change her coloration, gaining a +4 bonus on Stealth checks in underwater environments. She can return to normal as a free action. This racial trait replaces energy resistance.
undine/undine_terrain_chameleon.json.name: Terrain Chameleon

undine/undine_water_sense.json.description: Undines with this racial trait can sense vibrations in water, granting them blindsense 30 feet against creatures in contact with the same body of water. This racial trait replaces energy resistance.
undine/undine_water_sense.json.name: Water Sense

vanara/tree_stranger_vanara_speed.json.description: Tree stranger vanaras have a base speed of 30 feet.
vanara/tree_stranger_vanara_speed.json.name: Normal Speed

vanara/vanara_ability_scores.json.description: Vanaras are agile and perceptive, but are also rather impish and mischievous.
vanara/vanara_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, -2 Charisma

vanara/vanara_languages.json.description: Vanaras begin play speaking Common and Vanaran. Vanaras with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Aklo, Celestial, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, and Sylvan.
vanara/vanara_languages.json.name: Languages

vanara/vanara_nimble.json.description: Vanaras have a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Stealth checks.
vanara/vanara_nimble.json.name: Nimble

vanara/vanara_prehensile_tail.json.description: A vanara has a long, flexible tail that she can use to carry objects. She cannot wield weapons with her tail, but the tail allows her to retrieve a small, stowed object carried on her person as a swift action.
vanara/vanara_prehensile_tail.json.name: Prehensile Tail

vanara/vanara_size.json.description: Vanaras are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
vanara/vanara_size.json.name: Medium

vanara/vanara_speed.json.description: Vanaras have a base speed of 30 feet and a Climb speed of 20 feet.
vanara/vanara_speed.json.name: Normal Speed

vanara/vanara_tree_stranger.json.description: Some vanaras have spent their lives among humans in centers of learning instead of traditional treetop homes. These vanaras treat all Knowledge skills as class skills, but lose their climb speed racial trait.
vanara/vanara_tree_stranger.json.name: Tree Stranger

vanara/vanara_type.json.description: Vanaras are humanoids with the vanara subtype.
vanara/vanara_type.json.name: Vanara

vanara/vanara_vision.json.description: A vanara can see twice as far as a human in dim light.
vanara/vanara_vision.json.name: Low-Light Vision

vanara/vanara_whitecape.json.description: The rare whitecape vanara clans have more in common with savanna-dwelling baboons than the jungledwelling monkeys that most vanaras resemble. Their stooping build grants them a +4 racial bonus to CMD when resisting a bull rush or trip. These vanaras usually have a thick mane of hair on the head and shoulders (called a "cape") and shorter tails. This racial trait replaces prehensile tail.
vanara/vanara_whitecape.json.name: Whitecape

vishkanya/vishkanya_ability_scores.json.description: Vishkanyas are graceful but often irrational.
vishkanya/vishkanya_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, -2 Wisdom

vishkanya/vishkanya_keen_senses.json.description: Vishkanyas receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.
vishkanya/vishkanya_keen_senses.json.name: Keen Senses

vishkanya/vishkanya_languages.json.description: Vishkanyas begin play speaking Common and Vishkanya. Vishkanyas with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Aklo, Draconic, Elven, Goblin, Sylvan, and Undercommon.
vishkanya/vishkanya_languages.json.name: Languages

vishkanya/vishkanya_limber.json.description: Vishkanyas receive a +2 racial bonus on Escape Artist and Stealth checks.
vishkanya/vishkanya_limber.json.name: Limber

vishkanya/vishkanya_poison_resistance.js.description: A vishkanya has a racial bonus on saving throws against poison equal to its Hit Dice.
vishkanya/vishkanya_poison_resistance.js.name: Poison Resistance

vishkanya/vishkanya_poison_use.json.description: Vishkanyas are skilled in the use of poison and never accidentally poison themselves when using or applying poison.
vishkanya/vishkanya_poison_use.json.name: Poison Use

vishkanya/vishkanya_sensual.json.description: You are trained in drawing attention to yourself. You gain a +2 bonus on any one Perform skill. This racial trait replaces keen senses.
vishkanya/vishkanya_sensual.json.name: Sensual

vishkanya/vishkanya_size.json.description: Vishkanyas are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
vishkanya/vishkanya_size.json.name: Medium

vishkanya/vishkanya_speed.json.description: Vishkanyas have a base speed of 30 feet.
vishkanya/vishkanya_speed.json.name: Normal Speed

vishkanya/vishkanya_subtle_appearance.js.description: You have normal (humanlike) eyes, and your beauty is more conventional. You gain a +4 bonus on Disguise checks to look fully human. This racial trait replaces low-light vision.
vishkanya/vishkanya_subtle_appearance.js.name: Subtle Appearance

vishkanya/vishkanya_toxic.json.description: times per day (a number equal to his Constitution modifier (minimum 1/day)), a vishkanya can envenom a weapon that he wields with his toxic saliva or blood (using blood requires the vishkanya to be injured when he uses this ability). Applying venom in this way is a swift action.
vishkanya/vishkanya_toxic.json.name: Toxic

vishkanya/vishkanya_type.json.description: Vishkanyas are humanoids with the vishkanya subtype.
vishkanya/vishkanya_type.json.name: Vishkanya

vishkanya/vishkanya_vision.json.description: Vishkanyas can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
vishkanya/vishkanya_vision.json.name: Low-Light Vision

vishkanya/vishkanya_weapon_familiarity.j.description: Vishkanyas are always proficient with blowguns, kukri, and shuriken.
vishkanya/vishkanya_weapon_familiarity.j.name: Weapon Familiarity

wayang/wayang_ability_scores.json.description: Wayangs are nimble and cagey, but their perception of the world is clouded by shadows.
wayang/wayang_ability_scores.json.name: +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, -2 Wisdom

wayang/wayang_dissolution_s_child.json.description: Once per day, you may change your appearance to look as if you were little more than a 4-foot-tall area of shadow. Your physical form still exists and you are not incorporeal--only your appearance changes. This works like invisibility, except it only lasts rounds (1 round per level, maximum 5 rounds). This is a supernatural ability. This racial trait replaces shadow magic.
wayang/wayang_dissolution_s_child.json.name: Dissolution's Child

wayang/wayang_languages.json.description: Wayangs begin play speaking Common and Wayang. Wayangs with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: any human language, Abyssal, Aklo, Draconic, Goblin, Infernal, Nagaji, Samsaran, and Tengu.
wayang/wayang_languages.json.name: Languages

wayang/wayang_light_and_dark.json.description: Once per day as an immediate action, a wayang can treat positive and negative energy effects as if she were an undead creature, taking damage from positive energy and being healed of damage by negative energy. This ability lasts for 1 minute once activated.
wayang/wayang_light_and_dark.json.name: Light and Dark

wayang/wayang_lurker.json.description: Wayangs gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Stealth checks.
wayang/wayang_lurker.json.name: Lurker

wayang/wayang_shadow_magic.json.description: Wayangs add 1 to the DC of any saving throws to resist spells of the shadow subschool that they cast. Wayangs with a Charisma score of 11 or higher also gain the following spell-like abilities: 1/day--ghost sound, pass without trace, and ventriloquism. The caster level for these effects is equal to the wayang's character level. The DCs of these spells are equal to 10 + the spell's level + the wayang's Charisma modifier.
wayang/wayang_shadow_magic.json.name: Shadow Magic

wayang/wayang_shadow_resistance.json.description: Wayangs get a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against spells of the shadow subschool.
wayang/wayang_shadow_resistance.json.name: Shadow Resistance

wayang/wayang_size.json.description: Wayangs are Small creatures and gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty on combat maneuver checks and to their Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.
wayang/wayang_size.json.name: Small

wayang/wayang_speed.json.description: Wayangs have a base speed of 20 feet.
wayang/wayang_speed.json.name: Slow Speed

wayang/wayang_type.json.description: Wayangs are humanoids with the wayang subtype.
wayang/wayang_type.json.name: Wayang

wayang/wayang_vision.json.description: Wayangs can see in the dark up to 60 feet.
wayang/wayang_vision.json.name: Darkvision
